xrefdescription.para: CSS-01: FeedbackSummary creation with required fields.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a FeedbackSummary can be constructed and its fields are accessible as documented.
Verifies that toJson() / fromJson() preserve all fields.

xrefdescription.para: CSS-03: FeedbackSummary shard_origin defaults to ANON.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that the default value for shard_origin is "ANON" as required by the privacy contract.

xrefdescription.para: CSS-04: publishFeedback() dispatches a gossip message.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that publishFeedback() calls the gossip function exactly once and increments publishedCount().

xrefdescription.para: CSS-05: handleInboundSummary() invokes the registered callback.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that after setting a feedback callback, processing an inbound summary payload calls the callback with the correct summary_id.

xrefdescription.para: CSS-06: publishFeedback() throws when embedding dimension is wrong.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that the embedding dimension validator rejects a summary whose reason_embedding length differs from max_embedding_dim.

xrefdescription.para: CSS-07: Duplicate inbound summary_id is deduplicated.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that sending the same payload twice results in receivedCount()==1 and deduplicatedCount()==1.

xrefdescription.para: CSS-08: Multiple distinct summaries all received.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that five distinct inbound summaries are all processed (no false-positive deduplication).

xrefdescription.para: CSS-09: Inbound policy check rejects summaries.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a policy check returning false causes the summary to be silently dropped and rejectedByPolicyCount() is incremented.

xrefdescription.para: CSS-10: ZeroTrust enforcer returning false throws on high-risk summary.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that when the ZeroTrust enforcer returns false, handleInboundSummary() throws std::runtime_error for the high-risk summary.

xrefdescription.para: CSS-11: getStats() returns a JSON object with expected counters.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that getStats() returns a JSON object containing at minimum "published" and "received" after some operations.
Verifies that a correctly constructed FeedbackSyncConfig reports isValid() == true, and that degenerate configs (dim=0) are rejected.

briefdescription.para: Focused unit tests for cross-shard feedback synchronization.

detaileddescription.para:
Tests the core distributed knowledge feedback sync paths against the actual production API surface:
FeedbackSummary creation and JSON round-trip
CrossShardFeedbackSync publish/receive lifecycle
Deduplication by summary_id
Inbound policy check and ZeroTrust enforcer
Observability counters (publishedCount, receivedCount, deduplicatedCount)
Target: Production readiness validation for feedback sync layer. Q3 2026 Hardening: dedup semantics, policy-edge feedback filtering, determinism.
